written: before any new fit (frozen in FIT_LOCK); generated from cbp.fit.bank()/new_fit_order()/reference_units() and cbp.run

counts.note: exact aliases (identical pair fingerprints) are counted after fitting with ``aliases``; an alias is still one fitted (or reused) unit, never an extra model fit
counts.real_data_control_jobs: cbp.audit.stage_controls (null, CONF_r1/r2, COLL_r1/r2, XOR, ROT_r1/r2, null calibration x5); plants in memory only
counts.auxiliary_note: the fine partitions (income 32 / occupation 128 per predicted class) are admitted from qpc (fine__s{k}); no fine-state refit

count_semantics: 72 logical privacy units = 24 REUSED endpoint units (lambda 0.01, 0.1; parity, no refit) + 48 NEW fits; exact aliases are counted after fitting and never add model fits; 9 reused references (DIRECT-TASK, FINE-TASK, CLASS-ONLY x 3 seeds); continuous sources (U, RAW-J) and REF|E/F/F0 are counted separately
fit_order: stage_fit: (1) endpoint parity of all 33 reused units -> run/endpoint_parity.json (any failure stops); (2) per (seed, new lambda): LOCAL, SEQ-12, SEQ-21, then JOINT with witnesses FINE-TASK + the same-lambda LOCAL/SEQ-12/SEQ-21
timing_estimate: TIMING.json (fitting: B synthetic full bank; audit: D)
resume: by unit hash and status (jcv.finalize.unit_complete); valid units are never overwritten
